claims.claim: Synthesize 4.5T tokens of high-quality, domain-specific, RL-oriented synthetic data to address data scarcity for underserved languages
claims.quote: to train effectively despite data scarcity for un- derserved languages, we synthesize 4.5T tokens of high-quality, domain-specific, and RL-oriented data

claims.claim: Progressive bilingual curriculum jointly optimizing composition, quality thresholds and domain coverage across 20T tokens
claims.quote: we coordinate this data through a progressive curriculum jointly optimizing composi- tion, quality thresholds, and domain coverage across 20 trillion tokens

claims.claim: SnapPO, a cyclic off-policy RL framework decoupling generation, reward computation and training for scalable multi-domain RL
claims.quote: We address this through SnapPO (Section 6), a cyclic off-policy framework that decouples these three stages into independent processes with cached intermediate results.

claims.claim: Solar Open: 102B total / 12B active MoE model trained on 20T tokens
claims.quote: Solar Open is built on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 102 billion total parameters and 12 billion active parameters per token
claims.ablation_quote: Training stability guides our remaining architectural decisions through comparative experi- ments between our 10B-A1B MoE prototype and a 3B dense baseline across 50B–100B training tokens.

data_disclosure.quote: 19.7T token corpus comprises: English General (13.0T), Math & Code (3.7T), Korean General (1.1T), Japanese (0.8T), Multilingual (0.8T), and Domain-Specific content

tokens_disclosed.quote: we prepare about 19.7 trillion tokens for the pre-training stage with two key innovations

coding.note: Compute set to N conservatively: only hardware (480 B200 GPUs) and a planned three-month target timeline are given (p6), not the actual GPU-hours. Rerun and scores_copied are NR because the report never says how comparator scores were obtained. The ARCH claim gets PARTIAL because the shared-expert and load-balancing ablations on the 10B-A1B prototype are described only in prose with no table, and the MoE-vs-dense comparison uses different sizes.
